subject: general
question: Which of the following states is home to the only mine in the country involved in industrial-scale mining of diamonds?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Madhya Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• India's **Madhya Pradesh** state, the only diamond mining domain in Asia, could be between the world's top ten diamond makers, studies have shown. 
 
• As of 2017, there was one industrial-scale diamond mine in India, the Majhgawan mine, close by the town of Panna, **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• **Diamond mining in India** extends back into age.
 
• From ancient times, India was the origin of nearly all the world's known diamonds, and up to the discovery of diamonds in South Africa in 1896, **India was the at most place where diamonds were mined. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Tamil Nadu** is the excessive creator of **bananas and coconuts** in the whole country.
 
• **Karnataka** is the biggest producer of **coarse cereals, coffee, raw silk and tomatoes** between the states in India.
 
• **Chhattisgarh** is a main producer of minerals such as **coal, iron ore and dolomite**.
